claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tyrphostin AG-99 is a weak, non-selective EGFR/tyrosine kinase inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to produce a class-specific EGFR-driven killing pattern and is expected to be largely inactive or only weakly cytotoxic.
